text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, warm-ups are all doooone.
...Guess I'll take it nice and easy today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "If I get out of shape, it's just exhausting and painful to run anyway—"

“—I'm totally serious, no holding back on this!
Fuji-san, please go all out for real!!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Pokke!
I'll show you a run that's like a "miracle"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are those two about to run together?
...I just wanna take it easy, so I'll stick to the edge~.

text_block_list.name: Fuji & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
...Heh!
...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Eh!? N-Not good!
At this rate, our courses are gonna overlap!
I-I have to shift lanes fast~!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Um, um, what was it again...?
The trick to my final spurt is—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a close one...
All thanks to your advice, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, sprinting is way too exhausting.
Trainer, don't you have any tips or anything?
choice_data_list: Think of it as “applying” rather than just “doing”.
Maybe think of it as “applying” rather than just “doing”.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Don't do it blindly." "Be conscious of where you step."
And then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll go run/gamble of my own free will!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I see.
Indeed, if it felt like that just now, it shouldn't be too rough—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, it all just hit me at once.
Got the hang of it now, so I'm heading back to my room~."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what was that acceleration just now?!
That was freaking awesome!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry about that!
I interrupted your tandem training, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're not in the way at all!
Though you certainly stole the show, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's go for a run right now!
I wanna race against ya!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, ah, sorry! You see...
Uh—right, right! I've gotta check with Trainer
about my training load first.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And so, sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Whew, that was close~. I almost got dragged
into that hardcore training session...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Having a Trainer who's too competent is a real dilemma~.
